title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 17 日

stories.headline_en: TSMC and AUO Collaborate on Advanced Packaging Technology
stories.headline_zh: 台積電與友達光電合作開發先進封裝技術

sentences.en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is partnering with AUO.
sentences.zh: 臺灣積體電路製造公司（台積電）正與友達光電合作。

sentences.en: They will jointly develop advanced packaging using glass substrates.
sentences.zh: 他們將共同開發使用玻璃基板的先進封裝技術。

sentences.en: This partnership aims to boost Taiwan's leading role in chip tech.
sentences.zh: 這項合作旨在提升臺灣在晶片技術的領先地位。

sentences.en: It makes the nation's position in the global supply chain stronger.
sentences.zh: 這鞏固了臺灣在全球供應鏈中的地位。

sentences.en: The new process could improve performance for future AI chips.
sentences.zh: 這項新製程可望提升未來人工智慧晶片的效能。

stories.headline_en: Apple Launches AI Health Research to Improve Medical Information
stories.headline_zh: 蘋果啟動人工智慧健康研究以提升醫療資訊

sentences.en: Apple has started a new research program for AI health tools.
sentences.zh: 蘋果公司已啟動一項新的人工智慧健康工具研究計畫。

sentences.en: It aims to improve the accuracy of medical information for users.
sentences.zh: 其目標是提升使用者醫療資訊的準確性。

sentences.en: The study includes 200,000 US iPhone users over a year.
sentences.zh: 這項研究將招募二十萬名美國 iPhone 使用者，為期一年。

sentences.en: Participants will evaluate AI answers to health-related questions.
sentences.zh: 參與者將評估人工智慧對健康相關問題的回答。

sentences.en: This initiative focuses on scientific validation and user privacy.
sentences.zh: 這項倡議著重於科學驗證與使用者隱私。

stories.headline_en: Philippines Expected to Lead Asia in Interest Rate Cuts Next Year
stories.headline_zh: 菲律賓預計明年將引領亞洲降息

sentences.en: The Philippines may be the first in Asia to cut interest rates.
sentences.zh: 菲律賓可能成為亞洲首個降息的國家。

sentences.en: This is due to easing inflation and slower economic growth.
sentences.zh: 這是因為通膨趨緩與經濟成長放緩。

sentences.en: Analysts predict the central bank will act next year.
sentences.zh: 分析師預測央行將於明年採取行動。

sentences.en: Lower rates could boost business investment and consumer spending.
sentences.zh: 較低的利率可能刺激商業投資和消費者支出。

sentences.en: This move aims to support the nation's general economic health.
sentences.zh: 此舉旨在支持該國整體經濟健康發展。
